path_1.MECHANICAL_CAUSE: TYPECHECK BREAK FROM AN ALREADY-AUTHORIZED RENAME, PLUS AN UNDISCHARGEABLE LABELLING COMMAND. (1) lib/portfolios/analytics.ts is an ALREADY-AUTHORIZED path under v1.0.0 unprotected.readiness_readers. Its exported PortfolioAggregate interface declares `averageReadinessScore: number | null` and `readinessCoverage: number` at base lines 43-44, neither optional. Discharging the frozen readiness_reader_contract.portfolio.b5_disposition renames them to averageLegacyManualReadinessScore and legacyManualReadinessCoverage. A `git grep` sweep for both identifiers across all *.ts and *.tsx at the candidate BASE returns exactly three files: lib/portfolios/analytics.ts (authorized), lib/portfolios/analytics.test.ts (authorized, enumerated in existing_tests) and app/app/portfolios/[portfolioId]/page.tsx (NOT enumerated), which reads agg.averageReadinessScore at lines 121, 122, 124 and 126 and agg.readinessCoverage at line 128. Renaming a non-optional interface field while a consumer still reads the old name is a TypeScript error, so the `typecheck` exit gate frozen in W2_B5_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.json cannot pass while this file is unmodified. (2) Independently, readiness_reader_contract.portfolio.b5_disposition COMMANDS that the legacy value 'must not be labelled, aggregated or presented as authoritative readiness'. Labelling and presentation occur in this page, not in analytics.ts - analytics.ts computes, the page renders the string the user reads. The frozen contract therefore issues a labelling obligation whose ONLY possible site of discharge lies outside its own closed world.
path_1.authorized_edit_scope: Consume the two renamed PortfolioAggregate fields, and change the human-readable label so the displayed value is explicitly marked as the legacy, non-authoritative manual score as readiness_reader_contract.portfolio.b5_disposition requires. Nothing else. No refactor. No change to the population predicate. No change to the formula sum(net social value)/sum(investment). No new data source. No new query. No change to any other section of the page. Any change beyond a forced rename consumption and the frozen label discharge is STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_DELTA.
path_1.behavioral_scope_delta_proof: The rendered NUMBER is bit-identical: the same aggregate is computed by the same code path in analytics.ts and rendered by the same Math.round expression, with only the property identifier changed. The only user-visible delta is the label STRING, which is the frozen contract's own explicit command, not a new behavior chosen here. No predicate, no formula, no query, no ordering and no rounding changes.
path_1.fibiu_27_boundary_respected: MEASURED. v1.0.0 prohibited_rationale.fibiu_27_30_surfaces reserves 'Portfolio's population predicate and formula' for FIBIU-27 (Wave 5), and readiness_reader_contract.portfolio.prohibited_in_b5 names exactly 'the population predicate and the formula sum(net social value)/sum(investment)'. The reservation is on the predicate and the formula, NOT on the display layer, and readiness_reader_contract.portfolio.future_owner confirms FIBIU-27's subject is the SOURCE switch - 'the manual readiness_score stops being a source' - which B5 explicitly does not perform. Labelling the legacy value as legacy is the precise opposite of annexing FIBIU-27: it preserves the legacy source while making its non-authoritative status explicit, exactly as v1.0.0 commands.

path_2.MECHANICAL_CAUSE: MOCK QUERY-SEQUENCE DESYNCHRONISATION FROM AN ALREADY-AUTHORIZED READER CHANGE. lib/stella/context/build-composer-context.ts is an ALREADY-AUTHORIZED path under v1.0.0 unprotected.readiness_readers, and v1.0.0 readiness_reader_contract requires the composer to stop sourcing readiness from sroi_run_reviews - stage_f_reader_finalization states that where the context is not repointed, 'an ABSENT/null readiness field is REQUIRED over a legacy manual value'. Discharging that removes the sroi_run_reviews SELECT from buildComposerContext entirely. This test file does NOT assert on readiness at all - it tests funder breakdown - but it drives the composer through an ORDER-DEPENDENT mock: a chained db.select() mock queued with one mockReturnValueOnce per query, in positional order, documented in the file's own header as steps 1..13 with '12. readiness review' and '13. report sections'. Removing one query shifts every subsequent position by one, so the queue's step-12 entry is consumed by the sections query and the final entry is never consumed. The file's assertions fail on data that has nothing to do with readiness. This is a POSITIONAL COUPLING, not a semantic dependency.

precedent_prohibition.BINDING: This amendment MUST NOT be cited to infer any future path.
precedent_prohibition.rule: The authorization of these four paths creates NO precedent for a fifth. It licenses no pattern, no directory, no family, no 'same kind of thing' and no analogical extension. A fifth mechanically forced path - in any batch, in any lane, at any time - is a fresh STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_DELTA requiring its own governed amendment with its own per-path necessity proof and, where ODS prohibited_surfaces is engaged, its own explicit ODS instruction.
specifically_prohibited_inferences: that app/app/portfolios/** is now open because one page in it is authorized
that lib/stella/** is now open, or that its explicit prohibition is generally weakened, because two exact files in it are authorized
that tests/eval/** or tests/eval/stella-roles/** is now open because one module in it is authorized
that any file consuming a renamed exported field is automatically authorized
that any fixture carrying a removed field is automatically authorized
that any test whose mock sequence desynchronises is automatically authorized
that a path is authorized because it is mechanically forced, without a governed authority object naming it
that 'it was already changed on a candidate branch' is ever a reason for authorization
precedent_prohibition.why_this_clause_exists: The recurring failure mode in this program is not an implementer inventing scope - it is a later mission reading a narrow, well-justified exception as a general permission. W2-B4's audit recorded a vacuous ODS_SCOPE=PASS obtained from a diff-derived allowlist. This clause and its deterministic controls exist so that the next reader cannot mistake four proven exceptions for an open surface.
